The '''Uhl Doaba'I''' was a rundown outbuilding at the edge of [[Vakeyya]] run by [[Ibhaan'I]] [[Shaman/Legends|shamans]]. The name translated as "the peaceful place," and the shamans were all experienced guides with knowledge of the [[Doaba Badlands]]. The shamans welcomed visitors and the chance to speak with off-worlders about their adventures and the worlds beyond [[Socorro/Legends|Socorro]]. Visitors who donate to the shamans would receive an [[osma bag]], a hand-picked bag of trinkets and items selected by the shaman that would be a representation of the life-destiny path of the receiver.<ref name="BSS" />
